account_exists_subtitle.description: Explanatory text on the existing-sign-in-method sheet. KEEP the {providers} token exactly as-is — the app replaces it with the provider name(s). English: "We found another sign-in method for this email. Use {providers} to continue, then we'll connect everything to the same account.".

open_login.description: FALLBACK — primary button on the existing-sign-in-method sheet, shown only when the existing method isn't a recognised provider; normally the button reads "Continue with Google/Apple/Email". Opens the log-in screen. English: "Open login".

account_exists_existing_provider_fallbac.description: FALLBACK — the word that fills the {providers} slot in the subtitle above, used only when the provider name(s) can't be determined; normally the real provider name(s) are shown. English: "your existing provider".

error_invalid_credentials.description: Error shown when the email or password is wrong. English: "Incorrect email or password".

error_too_many_requests.description: Error shown only after too many failed sign-in attempts. English: "Too many attempts. Please try again later".

error_session_persistence.description: Error shown only when sign-in succeeds but the session couldn't be saved. English: "Signed in, but failed to restore your session".

error_generic.description: Fallback error shown when sign-in fails for any other reason. English: "Failed to sign in".

restore_password.description: Forgot/restore-password screen: the user enters their email to receive a password-reset link.

title.description: Header at the top of the restore-password screen.

description.description: Short intro line under the header telling the user to enter their email so a reset link can be sent.

email_label.description: Label above the email input box.

email_placeholder.description: Greyed-out hint text inside the empty email input box.

submit.description: Main button that sends the password-reset request.

error_invalid_email.description: Error shown under the email field only when the entered email is empty or not a valid address.

restore_password_email_sent.description: Confirmation screen shown after the password-reset email has been sent: a centered message with an email icon, and an OK button.

message.description: Centered confirmation text shown after the reset email is sent, telling the user an email has been sent and to check their inbox. Contains a line break that should be kept.

ok.description: Label of the button at the bottom that dismisses the confirmation and returns the user to the sign-in flow.

create_account.description: Create-account flow: the sign-up landing/method-chooser screen (heading, consent, skip) and the email sign-up form (fields, buttons, errors) reached by tapping "Continue with Email".

screen_title.description: Main heading on the sign-up landing screen — the default wording, "Let's now create your account!" (gate and onboarding-start entry points use other keys not in this leaf).

screen_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the main heading, explaining that creating an account saves progress and unlocks features.

error_check_consent.description: Error shown only when the user taps a sign-up option without first ticking the consent checkbox.

skip_and_explore.description: Bottom button on the sign-up landing screen that skips account creation and continues into the app (default wording).

title.description: Top-bar title on the email sign-up form (the screen reached by tapping "Continue with Email").

email_label.description: Label above the email field on the email sign-up form.

email_placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the empty email field.

password_label.description: Label above the password field on the email sign-up form.

password_placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the empty password field.

submit.description: Main button on the email sign-up form that creates the account.

creating.description: Replaces the submit button label while the account is being created.

error_invalid_email.description: Error under the email field, only if the server rejects the address as invalid; the form's own live check normally catches a bad email first.

error_weak_password.description: Error under the password field, only if the server rejects the password as too weak; the form already requires 6+ characters (with a number) before you can submit.

error_too_many_requests.description: Error shown only after too many failed sign-up attempts in a short time.

error_session_persistence.description: Error shown only when the account was created but the app couldn't restore the login session.

error_generic.description: FALLBACK — shown when sign-up fails for a reason not covered by the more specific messages above; normally one of those is shown.

error_email_in_use.description: Appears unused — email collisions show the “You already have an account” sheet instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_email_in_use.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

login_with_existing_account.description: Appears unused — its button is gated by a flag that is never turned on, so it can’t currently show. Kept pending a product decision.
login_with_existing_account.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_google_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Google sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_google_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_apple_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Apple sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_apple_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_facebook_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Facebook sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_facebook_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_provider_cancelled.description: Appears unused — a cancelled social sign-in is dismissed silently with no message. Kept pending a product decision.
error_provider_cancelled.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

consent_label.description: The "I agree to WeMeditate's Terms & Conditions … Privacy Policy" line, with tappable links, next to the consent checkbox on the sign-up landing screen. Keep both link phrases intact.

navigation.description: The four labels on the bottom navigation bar, shown on every main screen (left to right: Daily, Path, Explore, Profile). If any label is missing a translation, the app silently falls back to the English word.

daily.description: First tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Daily".

path.description: Second tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Path".

explore.description: Third tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Explore".

profile.description: Fourth tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Profile".

general.description: Generic button/action labels reused across the app, mostly on error and confirmation screens.

back.description: "Back" button shown on the meditation player's error screen (when a meditation fails to load), next to Retry, to return to the previous screen.

retry.description: "Retry" button shown on failed/unavailable screens (meditation player and talk player load failures, and the profile screen's load error) to try loading again.

undo.description: "Undo" action shown briefly in a message after removing a favourite, letting the user restore it.
